statement: Pinned SDL Wii HIDAPI initializes runtime stick-calibration state only for the Wii U Pro, Gamepad (Classic-family) and Nunchuk categories. Its first observed stick sample sets the center and is not emitted as an axis event; subsequent samples adapt extrema and apply deadzones during axis normalization. This is host-side runtime calibration, not a read of extension calibration registers or proof of retail defaults.

applicability.revision: Emulator or Linux/SDL host source behavior; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: SDL_hidapi_wii.c:594-625 category-specific initialization,882-915 runtime normalization (first center sample at 885-888 is not emitted). No device register calibration read in this behavior.
